hook_note: Denial first, admission second — 'COVID did not come from an animal, the US just admitted it.' Rests on the published US position (whitehouse.gov/lab-leak, CIA Jan 2025), which says lab origin. The video never says engineered or weapon.

lines.en: COVID did not come from an animal.
lines.vo_direction: Cold, flat, absolutely certain. No warm-up.

lines.en: The United States just admitted it.
That is not the disturbing part.
lines.vo_direction: Drop the volume. This is the retention line.

lines.en: Sixteen days after the world shut down,
lines.vo_direction: Story voice. Keep it moving, no full stop at the end.

lines.en: the Pentagon's own intelligence agency writes a document.
June. They run the genome. Three scientists conclude: manipulated.
lines.vo_direction: Pace back up, then isolate the last word and drop pitch.

lines.en: August twenty twenty-one. The President is briefed.
That conclusion, reportedly, never enters the room.
lines.vo_direction: Quietest line in the video. Throw it away.

lines.en: For six years the answer stayed one word. Unknown.
It took a court order to get those pages out.
They didn't discover anything. They caught up to their own file.
lines.vo_direction: Lean in. Land hard on 'their own file'.

lines.en: The question was never what happened.

lines.vo_direction: Full stop before this. Clean, no push.
